artboards.title: 3 · The draft — guidance in the moment

annotations.text: THE FLOW, LEFT TO RIGHT — Home (1) hands off one decision; the questions (2) sharpen the letter with 2–3 taps; the draft (3) puts the law and the guidance beside the words; Send (4) starts the clock and files the evidence; when the answer comes back (5), the same flow runs again, seeded from the reply. Read Main (far left) first for the why.

WHAT'S ACTUALLY NEW — only draftQuestions.ts and the wiring that skips the template/tone picker. The AI fill, the blank-finder, the statutory clock, the paper trail, the case file and Gmail send are all shipped and tested. This is a wiring phase with one new module — which is why it's affordable right after Phase 6.
